description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Double Crystarium Mode II (Ice, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Future Hunter Mode I (Noel)] and [(Ice/Water) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Future Hunter Mode I (Noel)
